author: New China TV
description: Heavy rain caused flooding in southwest China's Yunnan, cutting off roads and disrupting supplies. Drones were used to deliver food, drinking water and daily necessities to villagers across the flooded areas.
title: Drones deliver supplies to villagers after floods cut off roads in Yunnan

author: New China TV
description:
Imagine charging an EV battery from 20% to 97% in just 12 minutes, in -30°C temperatures.
That's what Chinese automaker BYD can do.
Join the Asia-Pacific Media Forum delegates on a tour to its headquarters in Shenzhen to see some tech breakthroughs from behind the scenes.
title: Inside BYD HQ: China's EV innovation drives global green mobility

author: New China TV
description: A treetop race with a clear winner! In southwest China's Yunnan Province, a white-cheeked gibbon appears to be teasing a group of macaques. While the macaques scramble through the branches trying to keep up, the gibbon is just vibing -- swinging effortlessly and setting a pace the others simply can't match.
title: Catch me if you can! Gibbon teases macaques in Yunnan

author: New China TV
description: Thirty-one people have been confirmed dead and 531 others remain missing as of 6 p.m. Friday after a mudslide struck Gyirong Port on the China-Nepal border in southwest China's Xizang Autonomous Region on Aug. 26, according to the local emergency response and rescue authorities. #XinhuaNews
title: Xinhua News | 31 dead, 531 missing after mudslide hits border port in China's Xizang

author: New China TV
description: Congratulating a popular national children's radio program on its 70th anniversary, Chinese President Xi Jinping urged professionals in children's culture to redouble efforts in nurturing a new generation of capable young people for the socialist cause. #XinhuaNews
title: Xinhua News | Xi urges greater efforts to nurture capable young people for socialist cause

author: New China TV
description:
Less than 5 meters in two hours. What made the road so difficult to reopen?
No road. Fast-flowing water. Unstable slopes. Massive rocks.
Watch how rescuers tackled one obstacle after another to reopen the route to the core area of Gyirong Port. #GyirongPort #Xizang #China #Rescue
title: Why was it so hard to reopen the road to Gyirong Port?

author: New China TV
description: Just hiked Beijing's Fragrant Hills with the Viatrix exoskeleton -- developed by Shanghai-based startup ULSrobotics. It adapts to your stride in two seconds, cuts effort by 40 percent, and makes steep trails feel effortless. Similar devices are now popping up at tourist spots across China. Click this video to see how AI-powered wearables are transforming the way we move.  #FutureChina
title: GLOBALink | What it's like to hike with AI-powered exoskeleton

author: New China TV
description: Local Tanzanians comprise about 80 percent of some 500 employees now building the Chinese-led Zanzibar Mangapwani new port project. For workers Abdallah and Mndeli, the project's effects are already felt in promotions earned, skills acquired and new professional ambitions. It's a legacy that goes beyond the infrastructure, touching the lives of locals. #China #Africa #Tanzania #Zanzibar #CHEC #Infrastructure #LocalEmployment
title: Chinese-led port project opens new career paths for Tanzanians

author: New China TV
description: China's maternity insurance system has continued to expand its coverage and strengthen support for childbirth, with measures to cut out-of-pocket spending on childbirth and ensure more benefits reach the public, according to the National Healthcare Security Administration on Friday. #XinhuaNews
title: Xinhua News | China expands maternity insurance coverage to foster birth-friendly society

author: New China TV
description: Chinese President Xi Jinping on Friday sent a congratulatory message to the 8th China-Russia Energy Business Forum held in Vladivostok, Russia. #XinhuaNews
title: Xinhua News | Xi sends congratulatory message to 8th China-Russia Energy Business Forum

author: New China TV
description:
They saw China online. Now they're here.
From viral videos of Chongqing to exploring 10+ Chinese cities, foreign travelers are coming to China to see it for themselves.
#Chongqing #ChinaTravel #InboundTourism
title: Foreign tourists flock to Chongqing, explore more of China

author: New China TV
description:
"I left a part of my heart in China."
Upon returning home to the U.S., retired teacher Ronald Sakolsky reflected on his 10-day trip to China, recalling his touching reunion with former students and desertification fighter Yin Yuzhen. #China #Friendship #Reunion
title: I left a part of my heart in China

author: New China TV
description: China announced on Friday its 1,274-member delegation for the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games, with 815 athletes set to compete across 38 sports and 369 events. #XinhuaNews
title: Xinhua News | China names 815 athletes for Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games

author: New China TV
description:
In Changchun, China's "City of Film," even the railway station looks like a roll of film.
The floor-to-ceiling windows at Changchun West Railway Station resemble strips of film - a fitting design for a city with a deep cinematic heritage.
#film #railway #scenery #China
title: Architecture meets film roll at railway station in China

author: New China TV
description: A woman held her sleeping child as she sat on the floor of a subway station, prompting a kind-hearted patrol officer to bring over a chair for the tired pair. #China #Kindness #Heartwarming
title: Heartwarming: Officer quietly brings chair to tired mom in subway station

author: New China TV
description: Asia's largest wide-body aircraft maintenance hangar has been put into operation in Shanghai. Boasting a span of 313 meters, a depth of 146 meters and a floor area of about 46,000 square meters, the hangar hall can accommodate maintenance work for nine wide-body aircraft and two narrow-body aircraft simultaneously.
title: Asia's largest wide-body aircraft maintenance hangar put into operation in Shanghai
